ops.text: uvx --isolated capt-hook test is never fully green in cc-transcript: the getaway plugin pack ships two environment-coupled nudge tests (getaway.onboard:nudge_d78e5911) that expect Warn but get None on machines/roots without getaway state — 2 failures out of ~1160 on every run, before any repo-local hook exists. Anyone gating on exit code 0 (the authoring-hooks skill says "green is the finish line") hits this and has to diff failure sets against a no-hooks baseline to prove their own hook is clean.
